about: Listed names' skeletons (#487, shelf/skeleton.ts, docs/spec/listed-doors.md §4.4): NFKC, case folding, whitespace, punctuation and default-ignorable code points removed, then Unicode's confusables mapping (UTS #39) from the version below, repeated until nothing changes. Every name in a `same` group has that group's skeleton; the names in an `apart` group have different ones. Names with invisible code points are in skeleton.test.ts, as \u escapes.

same.about: the issue's example: case, a zero for an O, spacing and a hyphen, and a Cyrillic Е
mixed scripts: a Greek omicron, Cyrillic а twice, and full-width letters
digits for letters: a one for an l, in any case
letters for letters: rn for m, and an Old Italic letter whose prototype M lowers to m
punctuation: dots, an exclamation mark, slashes and a Unicode hyphen
a Greek sigma at a word's end or inside one

apart.about: an accent is a different letter, not a look-alike
a capital I for an l in a mixed-case name: case folding reads it as i first (§4.4)
